an8.29:1.1: 29 khaṇakicco loko khaṇakicco lokoti bhikkhave assutavā puthujjano bhāsati no ca kho so jānāti khaṇaṃ vā akkhaṇaṃ vā
an8.29:1.4: idha bhikkhave tathāgato ca loke uppanno hoti arahaṃ sammāsambuddho vijjācaraṇasampanno sugato lokavidū anuttaro purisadammasārathi satthā devamanussānaṃ buddho bhagavā dhammo ca desiyati upasamiko parinibbāniko sambodhagāmī sugatappavedito
an8.29:1.6: ayaṃ bhikkhave paṭhamo akkhaṇo asamayo brahmacariyavāsāya.
an8.29:2.1: puna caparaṃ bhikkhave tathāgato ca loke uppanno hoti …pe… satthā devamanussānaṃ buddho bhagavā dhammo ca desiyati upasamiko parinibbāniko sambodhagāmī sugatappavedito
an8.29:4.2: ayañca puggalo aññataraṃ dīghāyukaṃ devanikāyaṃ upapanno hoti …pe…
an8.29:5.2: ayañca puggalo paccantimesu janapadesu paccājāto hoti so ca hoti aviññātāresu milakkhūsu yattha natthi gati bhikkhūnaṃ bhikkhunīnaṃ upāsakānaṃ upāsikānaṃ
an8.29:6.1: …pe… ayañca puggalo majjhimesu janapadesu paccājāto hoti so ca hoti micchādiṭṭhiko viparitadassano
an8.29:6.2: natthi dinnaṃ natthi yiṭṭhaṃ natthi hutaṃ natthi sukatadukkaṭānaṃ kammānaṃ phalaṃ vipāko natthi ayaṃ loko natthi paro loko natthi mātā natthi pitā natthi sattā opapātikā natthi loke samaṇabrāhmaṇā sammaggatā sammāpaṭipannā ye imañca lokaṃ parañca lokaṃ sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā pavedentīti …pe…
an8.29:7.2: ayañca puggalo majjhimesu janapadesu paccājāto hoti so ca hoti duppañño jaḷo eḷamūgo na paṭibalo subhāsitadubbhāsitassa atthamaññātuṃ
an8.29:7.3: ayaṃ bhikkhave sattamo akkhaṇo asamayo brahmacariyavāsāya.
an8.29:8.1: puna caparaṃ bhikkhave tathāgato ca loke anuppanno hoti arahaṃ sammāsambuddho …pe… satthā devamanussānaṃ buddho bhagavā
an8.29:8.2: dhammo ca na desiyati upasamiko parinibbāniko sambodhagāmī sugatappavedito ayañca puggalo majjhimesu janapadesu paccājāto hoti so ca hoti paññavā ajaḷo aneḷamūgo paṭibalo subhāsitadubbhāsitassa atthamaññātuṃ
an8.29:8.3: ayaṃ bhikkhave aṭṭhamo akkhaṇo asamayo brahmacariyavāsāya.
an8.29:9.1: ime kho bhikkhave aṭṭha akkhaṇā asamayā brahmacariyavāsāya.
an8.29:10.1: eko ca kho bhikkhave khaṇo ca samayo ca brahmacariyavāsāya
an8.29:10.3: idha bhikkhave tathāgato loke uppanno hoti arahaṃ sammāsambuddho vijjācaraṇasampanno sugato lokavidū anuttaro purisadammasārathi satthā devamanussānaṃ buddho bhagavā
an8.29:10.4: dhammo ca desiyati upasamiko parinibbāniko sambodhagāmī sugatappavedito ayañca puggalo majjhimesu janapadesu paccājāto hoti so ca hoti paññavā ajaḷo aneḷamūgo paṭibalo subhāsitadubbhāsitassa atthamaññātuṃ
an8.29:10.5: ayaṃ bhikkhave eko khaṇo ca samayo ca brahmacariyavāsāyāti.
